summary: Gate zero passed for both candidates (shlink LICENSE MIT 249a8196..., sqlpad LICENSE.md MIT 93dec0b7...) with archives re-verified byte-identical offline. The spike stopped before the witness stage on two named gaps: the frozen React adapter refuses shlink's ejected-CRA tree (no react-scripts/Vite declaration), and shlink's own baseline cannot build on this host (webpack4 md4 hash, then node-sass 4.12 arm64/Node24 refusal). Comparator run on sqlpad's client showed migrate materialises only an entry document (1 written, 167 copied), not an installable Vite tree. Ledger: 37s machine, ~22min operator, 0 builds, 0 witness passes, 0 new TS lines. Verdict threeUnitsCredible=false (unreached, not refuted). tsc, lint, new test, freeze composite 27741d9c all verified; full node suite not run before budget.
open_questions: Re-cut the thin-wrapper measurement on an app the frozen adapter actually admits? react-sqlpad-v5-5-0's client is claimed by the adapter and its baseline/target lanes are already installed (544MB each on disk), so a re-cut could reach build+witness cheaply — but its journey needs the live-backend path and would return a bounded outcome.

Does the board want an admission-widening finding (ejected-CRA / vendored-webpack React trees) carried into the brief as a coverage item alongside Direction 1, given it blocks apps from having a per-app cost at all?

Should era-cell provisioning be treated as a runner-pool architecture requirement (x64 or multi-Node hosts) rather than only an automation task, given node-sass 4.x has no arm64 binding at any Node version available here?
